name: Fits Of Anger
overview: Scripture reveals that controlling fits of anger is a mark of wisdom and strength, as being slow to wrath reflects great understanding and self-mastery surpassing even physical might. Gentle responses can defuse anger, while harsh words escalate conflict, highlighting the importance of measured speech in maintaining peace. The Proverbs warn against associating with angry or furious individuals, cautioning that such relationships can lead to spiritual harm and entrapment. Overall, the Bible encourages believers to govern their spirit, pursue patience, and avoid the folly of hasty anger.
